scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @sweet-juniper/server" "npm run dev --workspace @sweet-juniper/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @sweet-juniper/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @sweet-juniper/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sweet-juniper/shared && npm run build --workspace @sweet-juniper/client && npm run build --workspace @sweet-juniper/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @sweet-juniper/shared && npm run lint --workspace @sweet-juniper/client && npm run lint --workspace @sweet-juniper/server
